name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 8 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 8 hours starting 2026-01-17, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.66 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
